statement: Configfs permits multiple compiled USB gadget functions to be created and linked into one configuration, then binds the configuration to a chosen USB Device Controller. This describes how f_hid and f_uac1/f_uac2 could share a composite configuration in principle; successful binding and streaming depend on available UDC endpoints and host/driver behavior.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Mainline configfs lifecycle; administrator provisioning and cleanup would be required. No root setup performed.
